summary: The recorded base independently reproduces the MXFP4 Triton post-load state_dict omission. At the exact candidate, its regression and independent GPU-backed storage, serialization, missing-key, and offload boundary cases pass. The patch is an issue-specific source fix rather than test-only hardening. Full GH200/gpt-oss-20b/TP=2 qualification remains unavailable on this AMD-only host.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before issue-specific reproduction: w13_weight was absent from state_dict after Triton-path post-processing, and wrapper-retained parameters were not protected from CPU offload.
Candidate regression: all runtime weights/scales remain registered and survive a safetensors sharded-state round trip; wrapper-backed parameters are excluded from OffloaderV1.

Independent MI355X/gfx950 cases: GPU storage pointer aliasing and strides, contiguous CPU safetensors snapshots, checkpoint-copy visibility in wrapper storage, detection of an omitted w2_weight, and mixed keep/offload behavior.
Candidate whitespace integrity and registered-test metadata consistency.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent adversarial storage and safetensors transport ran on the single assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. This was not NVIDIA triton_kernels execution.

remaining_limitations: The openai/gpt-oss-20b weights were unavailable, so the reported 13G-versus-4G export comparison, full save/reload, and semantic output comparison were not run.

The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950, while the original report used GH200 and the affected runtime backend is NVIDIA triton_kernels. Layout conversion was mocked with the same wrapper storage interface; real NVIDIA swizzle and kernel execution remain unverified.
TP=2, multi-GPU, and multi-node behavior were not exercised.
The candidate changes no native source; native rebuild was not applicable.
